texts: Welcome to Quiz Rush! Hungry? Today we're travelling the world through food. Forty famous dishes, from Easy to Genius. You have ten seconds each. Ready? Let's eat... I mean, let's play!
Kick-off! Here's your first dish. Any idea?
Yes! It's Pizza. Pizza Margherita is said to be named after Queen Margherita of Italy.
Take a good look. Which dish is this?
That's Sushi. Sushi comes from Japan, and the word refers to the vinegared rice.
Easy one... or is it? Name this dish!
It's Hamburger. It is named after the German city of Hamburg.
Eyes on the screen. What dish do we have here?
Correct answer: Tacos. Tacos come from Mexico and are made with corn tortillas.
You've seen this one before. Which dish?
Of course, it's Croissant. Its name means crescent in French.
Quick! Which dish is this?
Boom! It's Paella. This rice dish comes from Valencia in Spain.
Trust your instinct. Name it!
Here it is: Spaghetti. Its name means little strings in Italian.
Don't overthink it. Which dish is this?
You got it, it's Pancakes. Pancakes are one of the oldest foods in the world.
This one is a classic. Which dish?
Spot on! It's Hot dog. Americans eat billions of hot dogs every year.
Last easy one! Which dish is this?
The answer is Fish and chips. Britain's famous takeaway since the 1800s.
Medium round! Things get trickier. Which dish is this?
Yes! It's Ramen. This noodle soup is one of Japan's most loved dishes.
Look closely at the details. Which dish?
That's Falafel. Falafel balls are made from chickpeas or fava beans.
Ten seconds on the clock. Name this dish!
It's Pad thai. Thailand's famous stir-fried rice noodles.
This one fools a lot of people. Which dish is it?
Correct answer: Lasagne. Layers of pasta, sauce and cheese from Italy.
Can you get this one right? Which dish?
Of course, it's Churros. These fried dough sticks are often dipped in chocolate in Spain.
Think carefully. What dish is this?
Boom! It's Dim sum. These small bites are often served in bamboo steamers.
Here's a tricky one. Name it!
Here it is: Burrito. Its name means little donkey in Spanish.
Got it already? Which dish is this?
You got it, it's Pho. Vietnam's famous noodle soup, often eaten for breakfast.
Keep that streak going! Which dish?
Spot on! It's Hummus. A creamy dip made from chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic.
Last medium question! Which dish is this?
The answer is Gyros. Greek meat cooked on a vertical rotisserie.
Hard round! Only the experts from here. Which dish is this?
Yes! It's Moussaka. Layers of eggplant, meat and creamy sauce, famous in Greece.
Not so easy now. Which dish?
That's Bibimbap. Its name means mixed rice in Korean.
Here's one for the experts. Name this dish!
It's Pierogi. These filled dumplings are a favourite in Poland.
Take your time... but not too much. Which dish?
Correct answer: Goulash. A paprika-rich stew from Hungary.
This one is a real head-scratcher. Which dish is it?
Of course, it's Poutine. Fries, cheese curds and gravy, from Quebec in Canada.
Big brain time! What dish is this?
Boom! It's Ceviche. Raw fish cured in lime juice, a national dish of Peru.
Lock in your answer! Which dish?
Here it is: Baklava. Layers of thin pastry, nuts and syrup.
Few people get this one. Do you?
You got it, it's Shakshuka. Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
Are you still with me? Which dish is this?
Spot on! It's Tagine. Named after the cone-shaped clay pot it's cooked in, from Morocco.
Last hard one! Which dish?
The answer is Borscht. This bright red soup gets its colour from beetroot.
Genius round! Only true masters get these. Which dish is this?
Yes! It's Haggis. Scotland's national dish, traditionally served with neeps and tatties.
Seriously tough now. Name this dish!
That's Feijoada. A black bean and pork stew, one of Brazil's national dishes.
If you know this one, you're a legend. Which dish?
It's Injera. This spongy flatbread from Ethiopia is used as both plate and spoon.
Deep cut! Which dish is this?
Correct answer: Pastel de nata. Portugal's famous custard tart, first made by monks in Lisbon.
Here's a rare one. What is it?
Of course, it's Khachapuri. A boat-shaped cheese bread from Georgia, topped with an egg.
No hints this time. Which dish?
Boom! It's Pavlova. Named after the Russian ballerina Anna Pavlova.
Almost there! Which dish is this?
Here it is: Laksa. A spicy coconut noodle soup from Malaysia and Singapore.
Only a handful of people will get this. Which dish?
You got it, it's Bobotie. Spiced minced meat with an egg topping, from South Africa.
Second to last! Name this dish!
Spot on! It's Rendang. A slow-cooked spicy beef dish from Indonesia.
Final question! Make it count. Which dish is this?
The answer is Nasi lemak. Malaysia's national dish: rice cooked in coconut milk.
That's the last bite! How many dishes did you get? Drop your score in the comments, and come back tomorrow, there's a brand new quiz every day on Quiz Rush!
